title: Hills Bancorporation 8-K — Stock Split Announcement
summary: Hills Bancorporation, a small Iowa-based bank holding company quoted on OTC Markets (symbol HBIA), announced a 2-for-1 stock split approved by its Board of Directors, with a record date of June 1, 2026 and distribution date of June 8, 2026. The split will increase authorized shares from 20,000,000 to 40,000,000 common shares, no par value, with all new shares issued in book-entry form through Computershare.
key_points: Hills Bancorporation is an emerging growth company and registered bank holding company headquartered in Iowa City, Iowa
Board of Directors approved a 2-for-1 stock split on April 20, 2026
Record date: June 1, 2026; distribution date: June 8, 2026
Authorized shares increase from 20,000,000 to 40,000,000 common shares, no par value
All equity awards (stock options, RSAs) will be proportionally adjusted—shares doubled, exercise prices halved
No physical stock certificates; shares issued via book-entry through Computershare transfer agent
